chatbot.title: MediTrace Health AI
chatbot.header_sub: Strictly Informational • Not a Doctor or Pharmacist
chatbot.disclaimer: I am an AI assistant, not a doctor or pharmacist. I can provide general medicine-related information and help you understand your records, but I cannot diagnose medical conditions or prescribe treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making medical decisions.
chatbot.emergency_warning: If you are experiencing a medical emergency, chest pain, or severe difficulty breathing, please contact emergency services immediately:
chatbot.input_placeholder: Ask about your medicines, stock, schedule, or safety...

legal.title: Important Medical & Legal Notice
legal.section1: MediTrace is an auxiliary management tool. It does not provide medical diagnoses or prescriptions.
legal.section2: Always check physical packaging and consult your doctor or certified pharmacist before modifying treatments.
legal.section3: Emergency Services: In life-threatening emergencies, immediately dial 112 or 108 (India) or your local emergency hotline.
